conventions.s: L0/d_LSS with L0 = V^(1/3); cube L_short = L0
conventions.fixed: volume V = L0^3 fixed under shape changes (det G = 1)
conventions.fisher: F=1/2 Tr[C^-1 dC C^-1 dC], fixed V, cube, X_d (E irrep), X_12 (T2 irrep)
conventions.beams: neglected (b_l^2 >= 0.978 at l<=40 for FWHM <= 30 arcmin)

low_k_truncation_fix.description: CAMB Delta_l==0 below x_c(l) (x_c=14.217 for 18<=l<=26) with a finite jump; continued as g_l*poly2 (g=j_l for T, j_l/x^2 for E) fitted on [x_c, x_c+3]
